description: The item route on a bare film: image_search({imageGroupNumber: '004528134', item: 5}) returns item 5 of that film — the Schuylkill County Orphans' Court docket — as its own group, with the 10th image as imageId. The predicate carries `item`, so a whole-film listing without it does not match here (it falls to image-search-any). Invented film; the record series and place are real. No item mock existed before #3549.
